spec.description: 60-day photo album pipeline: interactive tracker for creating a gift-quality Printique layflat album from curation through print. Daily tasks, phase tracking, theme selection, 5-pass curation methodology, and Printique specifications.

tools.description: Show the 60-day album pipeline dashboard with phase progress, daily task completion, photo counts, page estimates, and cost projection. Use this to see overall project status.

action.description: Action: 'view' to see dashboard, 'start' to begin a new pipeline, 'reset' to start over, 'set_start_date' to change start date

startDate.description: ISO date string for when the 60-day pipeline begins (YYYY-MM-DD)

recipient.description: Who the album is a gift for

pipeline.albumTitle: Golden Hours — A Year in Light

tools.description: Show today's specific task based on the current pipeline day and phase. Each task has clear instructions, tips, and a completion button. Also allows completing or skipping tasks.

action.description: Action: 'view' for today's task, 'complete' to mark done, 'skip' to skip, 'view_day' to see a specific day

day.description: Specific day number (1-60) to view or complete

notes.description: Optional notes when completing a task

task.title: Flag 40 Candidate Photos (Day 5 of 5)
task.description: Browse your photo library and flag 40 more candidates. Focus on images that evoke strong emotional responses.
tips: Look for images with strong light and shadow
Consider photos that tell a story
Don't overthink — trust your gut reaction

tools.description: Show Printique layflat album specifications, pricing, paper options, cover materials, recommended specs, image resolution requirements, Lightroom export settings, and cost breakdown.

section.description: Which section to view: 'overview' for all specs, 'pricing' for cost details, 'export' for Lightroom settings, 'recommended' for first-album recommendations

tools.description: Browse and select from 5 curated album theme concepts. Each theme includes concept description, recommended page count, layout style, mood guidance, and photo selection criteria. Picking a theme sets the creative direction for the entire pipeline.

action.description: Action: 'browse' to see all themes, 'select' to pick a theme, 'custom' to define your own

themeId.description: Theme ID to select: golden_hours, street_life, landscapes_light, year_in_photos, one_trip_one_story

customTheme.description: Description of a custom theme if action is 'custom'

themes.name: Golden Hours
themes.tagline: Best sunrise & sunset shots across all trips
themes.layoutStyle: Full-bleed hero images with minimal text
themes.selectionCriteria: Strong golden/blue hour light, silhouettes, reflections, long shadows

tools.description: The 5-pass curation methodology for narrowing 124K photos to 40-50 album-ready images. Shows each pass with criteria, tips, common mistakes, time estimates, and progress tracking.

action.description: Action: 'view' for the full checklist, 'update_pass' to record pass progress, 'tips' for a specific pass

passNumber.description: Pass number (1-5) for update or tips

remainingCount.description: Number of photos remaining after this pass

notes.description: Notes about what was culled or kept

passes.name: Emotional Impact
passes.criteria: Does it make you feel something?

passes.name: Visual Variety
passes.criteria: Avoid repetition in subject, color, composition
